The class teacher tells the counselor that he thinks the vast majority of students like to play basketball, a small part likes to play badminton, and almost no one likes to play volleyball. After the counselor investigates, he finds that only 5 students like to play badminton.

[Question]
After the counselor investigates, how many students does he estimate like to play basketball?

[Candidate Answers]
A. After the counselor investigates, he estimates that 35 students like to play basketball.
B. After the counselor investigates, he estimates that 28 students like to play basketball
C. After the counselor investigates, he estimates that 20 students like to play basketball
D. After the counselor investigates, he estimates that 25 students like to play basketball.
